up: Retrieve exactly 1000 activity rows for IC50 measurements against the human single-protein target CHEMBL1974. Apply filters: activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1974', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', and target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606. Join target_dictionary, assays, activities, compound_structures, and molecule_dictionary. Return columns in this exact order: assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, then assays.chembl_id ASC. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM target_dictionary JOIN assays ON target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid JOIN activities ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1974' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
